question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (Cat III AIF) wants to onboard (i) an external individual investor and (ii) an employee of the Investment Manager. What are the minimum investment amounts applicable?

answer.text: External: INR 25 lakh; Employee: INR 25 lakh
External: INR 1 crore; Employee: INR 25 lakh
External: INR 1 crore; Employee: INR 1 crore
External: INR 25 crore (LVF); Employee: INR 1 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: The minimum investment by an external (non-Accredited) investor in an AIF is INR 1 crore. For employees/directors of the AIF or Investment Manager participating in their individual capacity, the minimum is INR 25 lakh. Accredited Investors are exempt from the INR 1 crore floor; an LVF requires INR 25 crore per AI investor. The Trap: Option A incorrectly lowers the external floor to the employee figure. Option C ignores the employee concession. Option D applies the LVF minimum which is not what the stem asks. Note: Workbook pages 105 and 399 set these minimums. For open-ended Cat III, the first lump-sum subscription must meet the applicable floor; additional contributions have no separate floor.
